captions.detailed: A professional-scale camera speedlight flash unit colored in matte black. It features a rectangular lower body housing the battery compartment and a rear control panel with a small blue screen surrounded by eight raised prismatic buttons. A vertical neck swivels continuously on top of the body, supporting a wide horizontal flash head with rounded side cheeks and a white diffuser lens. The head is cradled by an exposed support bracket and pivots on a horizontal tilt axis using two large grey cylindrical hinge pins.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional speedlight camera flash as an articulated model. The main body should feature a rear control panel with a small screen and several independent raised buttons. It must connect to a vertical neck that swivels continuously, supporting a horizontal flash head with rounded cheeks, a front diffuser lens, and a horizontal tilt mechanism with visible side hinge pins.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a rounded Box with a rear extrusion for the control panel, adding a small screen and multiple small boxes for the buttons. Create the neck using a vertical Cylinder connected to a continuous joint. Build the head support cradle using a horizontal box with perpendicular uprights, and mount the flash head (a box with rounded side cylinders and a front white diffuser plate) onto it via a revolute joint with grey hinge cylinders.
